Identity concepts

Ten directions for Moving2Valencia. Every mark is built on a 100-unit grid with a single idea held in its shape or negative space, all type is outlined from real fonts with proper kerning, and each one is tested in reverse, one-colour, app-icon and favicon sizes.

One idea per markNegative spaceGrid-built geometryWorks in one colourLegible at 16 pxRooted in place

01Casa Naranja

A home cut from an orange in pure negative space — Valencia’s symbol and the promise of arriving, in one shape. Reads instantly even at favicon size.

App icon
48 · 32 · 16 px

02The Journey 2

The “2” in the name drawn as a single route: an open ring for where you start, a solid dot for home. One line, one guide.

App icon

03Serranos M

The Torres de Serranos — the medieval gate into Valencia — reduced to a crenellated block whose two arches form an M. Heritage, entrance, trust.

App icon
48 · 32 · 16 px

04Llave V

A bold V with a keyhole held in its negative space: Valencia unlocked. Two caps above recall the gate towers.

05Horizonte

Sun over the Mediterranean; the roofline appears only in the gap between them. Calm, optimistic, unmistakably coastal.

06Azahar

Valencia’s orange blossom, where each of the five petals is a little house — a community of neighbours blooming from one centre.

07Punto Naranja

A location pin whose window is an orange slice. Direct and functional for maps, apps and signage.

08m2v Monogram

A tight serif monogram in a soft square — the “2” in Fraunces’ wonky italic as the warm accent. Built for app icons and social avatars.

09Firma

Wordmark only: refined Instrument Serif with an italic orange “2” as the signature flourish. Quiet luxury, editorial confidence.

10Sello 2008

A heritage seal built around the Serranos M, with the name and founding year set around the ring. For documents, stickers and stamps.

Concept stage · Type: Fraunces, Instrument Serif, Outfit (SIL Open Font License) · Final marks would receive manual optical refinement and a custom-drawn “2”.
